images.scene: Seen from across a small 1950s haulage company office at dusk: the owner sitting alone behind his wooden desk, tired, hands clasped in front of his face, facing an EMPTY wooden chair on the near side of the desk, dim light from a desk lamp, a few papers on the desk. The desk, the man and the empty chair fill the bottom half of the frame, bleeding off the bottom edge. The wall above them is bright, pale, hazy and empty.

Inside a small 1950s haulage company office: a warehouse worker in work clothes sitting on the near chair with his BACK to the camera, head bowed low, shoulders slumped, while the owner sits behind the desk facing him in soft focus, mid conversation, serious. The two figures and the desk fill the bottom half of the frame, bleeding off the bottom edge. The wall above is bright, pale, hazy and empty.

A plain meeting room in a 1950s freight depot at morning briefing time: ONE empty wooden chair at the near end of the long table, in sharp focus in the foreground, while blurred figures occupy the other chairs further away down the table. The table and chairs fill the bottom half of the frame, bleeding off the bottom edge. The wall above is bright, pale, hazy and empty.

Close view of a mechanic's hands on a wooden workbench in a freight depot, straining to tighten a completely stripped worn-out bolt with a wrench, the bolt thread visibly ruined and chewed, a few small parts scattered on the bench. The hands and bench fill the bottom half of the frame, bleeding off the bottom edge. The space above is bright, pale, hazy and empty.

Close view of a man's hands giving up on a repair: laying a heavy wrench down flat on the workbench and letting go, palms opening just above the tool, the broken part pushed aside. At the loading dock of a 1950s freight depot: one pair of older hands pointing at an item on a clipboard while a younger man's hands hold a wooden crate right beside it, the gesture of teaching the right way to do the job, no faces visible. Still life on a clean wooden workbench under hard raking light: a cast metal machine part broken clean in two, the two halves clumsily joined back together with adhesive tape wrapped around the break, an obviously futile hopeless repair, seen close. The part sits low in the frame on the bench surface, bleeding off the bottom edge. The space above is bright, pale, hazy and empty.

Inside the cab of a vintage truck rolling down a long straight road: the driver's forearms CROSSED over his chest, both hands completely OFF the large steering wheel, exactly two arms and two hands, the pale hazy road ahead seen through the windshield, bright overexposed daylight outside.
